shadows.name: preview
shadows.value: Perspective-projected extruded shell and bevelled vector front
shadows.purpose: Upper selected-game cartridge; native lifecycle-scoped rotation only.

nativeComponents.name: Cartridge
nativeComponents.description: Real icon, accessible full title, native ripple and mint corner focus; HOME is square and icon-only.

nativeComponents.name: Preview
nativeComponents.description: Actual selected-game icon on the front of a rotating extruded cartridge; moulded back without a mirrored label, upright title/metadata in licensed retro lettering. Stops when hidden or paused and respects disabled system animations.

nativeComponents.name: Utility strip
nativeComponents.description: Games, Search, Options and All Apps change the upper page with one persistent lower library.

nativeComponents.name: Selected-game shelf
nativeComponents.description: Full title, Properties and Open; empty libraries disable launch.

nativeComponents.name: Console indicator
nativeComponents.description: Selected console above the unchanged lower grid; no backend branding, hidden for no selection and not a focus target.

nativeComponents.name: Active-session shelf
nativeComponents.description: Paused-game identity, directly resumable icon and title-specific configuration gear.

nativeComponents.name: Android app tile
nativeComponents.description: Real installed launcher icon and wrapping name; normal Android launch intent.

nativeComponents.name: Status strip
nativeComponents.description: Retro-lettered native clock and real blue battery; invisible during system focus loss/status-bar reveal, restored after dismissal.

assets.provenance: Embedded impeccable:provenance PNG iTXt record contains the complete generation recipe.
Original generic beveled cartridge; no Nintendo cover art or proprietary assets.
SIL OFL 1.1; bundled copyright/license at assets/licenses/PixelifySans-OFL.txt. Not Nintendo lettering.

keyCharacteristics: Permanently silver-white Games, Search, All Apps and Options with a persistent lower game library.
Square icon-only cartridges with full-title accessibility labels.
Static embossed texture, shallow native elevation and immediate mint selection.
Existing Android navigation, dialogs, system Back and controller affordances.
dos: Do use actual game icons, metadata and existing native actions.
Do preserve visible focus, system Back, scalable text and native touch targets.
Do keep HOME and emulation presentation ownership separate.
donts: Don't restore tall Material cards as the HOME visual direction.
Don't fabricate Nintendo utilities, banners or cover art.
Don't add continuous visual work or change renderer settings for the HOME theme.
